shared_elements: small figures adjacent to a larger animal
registers/grouping of animals in a row
justification: Both surfaces show profile quadrupeds together with schematic human-like figures, and in each a small figure appears close to a much larger animal, but this is about as generic as figurative imagery gets. A shows a static vertical stack of registers with crouching predators, birds, a large bird-headed creature and abstract net/zigzag motifs, while B shows a lively horizontal hunting scene of many running, weapon-bearing men converging on an outsized antlered stag and a bull; the compositional logic, postures and rendering conventions (blocky relief carving vs. flat silhouetted, spindly-limbed dynamic figures) are quite different.
